instruction: I need to standardize my presentation by changing all text to 'Ubuntu' font at 20 point size. Can you help me apply this formatting globally?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text to Ubuntu font at 20pt size. Evaluator verifies both conditions with partial credit: 0.5 for correct font, 0.5 for correct size.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 points for using only Ubuntu font, 0.5 points for using only 20pt size
